_note: Latest published supply/demand balances, typed in from the publisher's own release (static; update when a new edition is out). Gold (WGC Gold Demand Trends) and copper (ICSG) are read from og-mining-v2/outlooks.json, not repeated here.

silver.src: The Silver Institute / Metals Focus, interim 2026 market review
facts: Sixth consecutive annual deficit; 2025 was 40.3 Moz (World Silver Survey 2026, April).
Global silver ETP holdings 1.25 bn oz on 3 Nov, 55 Moz lower since the start of the year; Metals Focus forecasts 45 Moz of net outflows for 2026.
Recycling forecast up 6%; jewellery −22% and silverware −17% on high prices.

platinum.src: World Platinum Investment Council, Platinum Quarterly Q3 2026 (Metals Focus data)
facts: Q3 2026 alone was a 110 koz deficit (supply 1,693 koz, demand 1,803 koz).
First 2027 forecast: back to a 279 koz deficit as investment demand recovers.
Above-ground stocks cover just over 3½ months of demand at end-2026; the 2025 deficit is now put at 1.5 Moz.

central_banks.src: World Gold Council, Central Bank Gold Statistics: September 2026
facts: Reported net purchases of 61 t in September, the highest month of 2026; Poland and China led.
Reported purchases year to date 228 t, 7% below the same period of 2025.
Including unreported buying, WGC puts Q3 central bank demand at 321 t (Gold Demand Trends Q3 2026).
